<!-- ===== JS: FILTRAGE GRID ===== -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const KEY = "mogadarr.romanFilter";
    const buttons = document.querySelectorAll(".chip");
    const vignettes = document.querySelectorAll(".book-vignette");

    function applyFilter(category) {
        vignettes.forEach(v => {
            if (category === "all" || v.dataset.cat === category) {
                v.style.display = "block";
                setTimeout(() => v.style.opacity = "1", 50); // Fade in
            } else {
                v.style.display = "none";
                v.style.opacity = "0";
            }
        });
    }

    // Restore last selection
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(KEY) || "all";
    applyFilter(saved);
    buttons.forEach(b => {
        if(b.dataset.filter === saved) b.classList.add("active");
    });

    buttons.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            // Remove active class from all
            buttons.forEach(b => b.classList.remove("active"));
            // Add to clicked
            btn.classList.add("active");

            const cat = btn.dataset.filter;
            applyFilter(cat);
            localStorage.setItem(KEY, cat);
        });
    });
});
</script>
